actionAdapters.when: 当前只能从 Framework 文档确认 Action 已注册；可信审批与 MCP allowlist 完成前不得 describe/plan/execute，执行请求返回 blocked

allow: ProjectSettings/AndroidResolverDependencies.xml produced by the confirmed EDM4U Force Resolve
Assets/GeneratedLocalRepo/** produced and managed by EDM4U
Assets/Plugins/Android/** files and templates explicitly tracked by EDM4U resolution state
deny: Packages/manifest.json, Packages/packages-lock.json, registry or resolved package contents
manual deletion or editing outside the exact EDM4U-managed file set
private Maven repository URL, userinfo, query token, credential or raw secret in Plan, Receipt, log or report
business Gradle/Manifest customization not tracked by EDM4U, Config, Scene, Prefab or business source
HybridCLR generation, Bundle or Player build, device installation, vendor dashboard, external write, Git commit or push

requiredFor: the exact frozen EDM4U dependency graph digest and complete managed write set
Force Resolve deletion or replacement of existing EDM4U-managed files and GeneratedLocalRepo output
any changed activeBuildTarget, dependency graph, managed path or execution entry
UPM change, build, device installation, credential use, external write, delete outside managed outputs, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认只绑定当前 Android Target、完整依赖图摘要和 EDM4U 精确受管写入集；任何图、路径、平台或入口漂移后旧确认失效。当前 MCP caller-asserted token 不是可信审批，故 Action 保持 blocked。

evidence: 冻结及执行前复核的 activeBuildTarget=Android、非空 EDM4U 依赖图和 SHA-256
不含私有仓库原值的 repository SHA-256 摘要与精确受管写入集
ResolveSync 明确成功标记；异常、失败或 domain reload 后未自动重放
AndroidResolverDependencies.xml 的 package/files/settings 与冻结图一致
全部 EDM4U 受管文件、GeneratedLocalRepo 与 Artifact SHA-256 的 Verify 证据
未执行 UPM、Gradle/Player 构建、设备、厂商后台、凭据、外部发布或 Git 的边界说明
